items.title: ANMA, boundary contracts for cheaper AI coding agents
items.raw_excerpt:
I built ANMA because I noticed that cheaper models would often ignore architecture rules. So I did several benchmarks using "Claude Haiku 4.5" with and without ANMA; without ANMA it ignored the "rules" 13 out of 19 runs, with ANMA, 0 out of 20 runs. What is "ANMA"? YAML contracts with CLAUDE.md, hooks, and CI checks What about stronger/expensive models?
They followed the architecture rules. The question is, would cheaper models with stronger rules be the best affordable default for coding?

title_i18n.en: ANMA, boundary contracts for cheaper AI coding agents
title_i18n.zh: ANMA，针对更廉价AI编程代理的边界合约
title_i18n.es: ANMA, contratos de límites para agentes de codificación de IA más baratos

excerpt_i18n.en:
I built ANMA because I noticed that cheaper models would often ignore architecture rules. So I did several benchmarks using "Claude Haiku 4.5" with and without ANMA; without ANMA it ignored the "rules" 13 out of 19 runs, with ANMA, 0 out of 20 runs. What is "ANMA"? YAML contracts with CLAUDE.md, hooks, and CI checks What about stronger/expensive models?
They followed the architecture rules. The question is, would cheaper models with stronger rules be the best affordable default for coding?
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我构建ANMA是因为注意到较便宜的模型常常忽略架构规则。于是我用Claude Haiku 4.5进行了多次基准测试，对比有无ANMA的情况；没有ANMA时，19次运行中有13次忽略了规则。
excerpt_i18n.es: Construí ANMA porque noté que los modelos más baratos solían ignorar las reglas de arquitectura. Así que realicé varias pruebas comparativas usando "Claude Haiku 4.5" con y sin ANMA; sin ANMA, ignoró las "reglas" en 13 de 19 ejecuciones.
